results.content:
Macaly Cloud is the latest in a string of updates from Macaly since joining team.blue in December 2025: the platform connected its agent to WhatsApp and Telegram, added direct payments and integrations with Google Maps, Instagram, or Airbnb earlier this year. As part of team.blue’s mission to make AI responsible & safe for its customers, Macaly also recently introduced a security audit that reviews a user’s site or app and helps them fix what it finds. Macaly Cloud represents Macaly’s most ambitious update yet, extending its infrastructure to the two AI assistants millions of people already use to write code.

Claude and ChatGPT get a place to publish [...] ## · Macaly Cloud is the latest step in team.blue's AI strategy, which already powers AI features across its portfolio of SaaS and hosting brands, serving 3.4 million customers in 23 countries

team.blue, the pan-European digital partner for small and medium businesses, today announced Macaly Cloud, opening its infrastructure to Claude and ChatGPT. Macaly Cloud is a new service from its AI vibe-coding platform Macaly that turns Claude and ChatGPT into complete websites and app builders. Users describe what they want directly in the Claude or ChatGPT chat they already use; the chatbot agent writes the code, and Macaly Cloud handles the database, hosting and a live domain, all on the AI subscription they already pay for. [...] Claude and ChatGPT get a place to publish

Claude and ChatGPT already write working code, and for a growing number of people they are where a new website or app begins. Getting that code online has so far been a separate job: hosting, a database, a domain, often a server, and the setup that holds it all together.

With Macaly Cloud, Macaly opens the infrastructure behind its own agent to Claude and ChatGPT. Claude or ChatGPT writes the code, and Macaly Cloud provides everything it needs to become a working product: a cloud sandbox, a database, builds, previews, production hosting and a domain. After every change, the agent returns a live link.
